source_summary: Tall hanging-scroll Chinese landscape with layered blue-green ink mountains, pine-lined ridges, scattered roof structures, pale water/mist intervals, rocky shorelines, and lower foreground tree-and-rock groups. Calligraphy, seals, margins, and paper tone are excluded.

motifs.name: upper_left_mountain_massif
motifs.description: Isolate the large jagged mountain mass in the upper left, including the angular peak, layered cliff faces, blue-green mineral washes, diagonal contour strokes, and sparse small trees on ledges. Exclude nearby seals and calligraphy.
must_preserve: tiny ledge trees and scrub marks

motifs.name: pine_ridge_distant_peak
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-upper sloping ridge running from center toward the right with a line of thin pines, low rounded hills, and the pale distant mountain behind it. Include the atmospheric empty wash around the distant peak but not the inscription above.

motifs.name: left_bank_hut_trees
motifs.description: Isolate the left midground bank with the small low hut or wall-like structure, surrounding boulders, sparse leafless trees, and low shrubs at the base of the upper mountain. Avoid including the large central cliff mass.

motifs.name: central_cliff_waterfall
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central vertical cliff face with descending pale waterfall or ravine lines, striated rock planes, angular ledges, and small dark texture strokes. Include the base rocks directly attached to the cliff but exclude neighboring pavilion clusters.
must_preserve: dark ledge outlines and base rocks

motifs.name: right_slope_pavilion_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the mid-right cluster of small roofed buildings embedded in the rocky slope, with adjacent pines, terraces, and angular paths descending along the cliff. Keep only the visible buildings and immediate supporting rocks/trees.
must_preserve: thin pine trunks and needle clusters
ink outlines with pale green wash

motifs.name: middle_shoreline_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the middle horizontal shoreline/island area with pale water around it, a low rounded bank, several tall slender trees, small rocks, and the right-hand cliff edge entering the scene.
must_preserve: small shoreline rocks and mist gaps

motifs.name: lower_tree_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the lower central grove of mixed trees rising from a rocky mound: a tall pine-like tree with horizontal foliage, drooping willow-like branches, smaller clustered trunks, and surrounding rocks. Exclude the separate hut on the right as much as possible.
must_preserve: tall pine trunk and flat needle masses
rock mound contours and root-like strokes

motifs.name: lower_right_hut_rocks
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right hut and rocky hillside cluster, including the small roof structure, slanted rock planes, vertical dark trees, and rounded foreground rocks. Avoid the central tree grove except where rocks touch the hut slope.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
